out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: OBSERVED BOTH CHEMICAL DISHWASHING MACHINES NOT DELIVERING SANITIZER (0PPM).
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC CONTACTED TECHNICIAN DURING INSPECTION TO REPAIR BOTH DISHWASHING MACHINES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF THAT BOTH MACHINES ARE SANITIZING AT THE PROPER CONCENTRATION AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the TILE GROUTING NEAR MOP SINK AND DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE REPAIR GROUTING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO PREVENT STANDING WATER ACCUMULATION.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED DISHWASHING MACHINE IN-USE AND DELIVERING A 0PPM OF SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION AND WILL ENSURE CONTRACTOR REPAIRS DISHWASHING MACHINE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PIC UNDERSTANDS DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR SANITIZING UNTIL IT CAN DELIVER 50-200PPM OF SANITIZER.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED BREADED CHICKEN (FOR BUFFALO CHICKEN SANDWICH) IN 2-DOOR RAW MEATS PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS DISCUSSED NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS REQUIREMENTS WITH PIC. PIC UNDERSTANDS PROCESS SHOULD BE DISCONTINUED AS OF NOW, AND WILL SUBMIT WRITTEN PROCEDURES TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WOULD LIKE TO CONTINUE THE PROCESS.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED (COMES FROZEN) SALMON ON A SHEET TRAY IN WALK-IN COOLER THAWING, WITH THE PACKAGING STILL INTACT. PACKAGING FOR THAWED SALMON IN TWO-DOOR UNDER-STOVE COOLER WERE OBSERVED SLIT OPEN.
violations.corrective_action: PIC SLIT PACKAGING FOR SALMON OPEN DURING INSPECTION. PIC WILL ENSURE STAFF UNDERSTAND THE PACKAGING FOR VACUUM-PACKAGED SALMON SHOULD BE SLIT OPEN OR THE PACKAGING SHOULD BE REMOVED WHEN THE THAWING PROCESS BEGINS. GLORY DAYS GRILL (Inspection Date: 05/21/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT DELIVERING SANITIZER, THEREFORE, DISH-WARE BEING WASHED WAS NOT SANITIZED.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD NOT BE USED TO WASH DISH-WARE/UTENSILS UNTIL IT CAN DELIVER SANITIZER. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF THAT IT CAN DELIVER SANITIZER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 50-52F IN LETTUCE COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED LETTUCE TO OTHER COLD HOLDING UNIT TO DROP TEMEPRATURE. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AND THIS UNIT SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED LETTUCE COOLER AT 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC REMOVED SHREDDED LETTUCE FROM UNIT AND MOVED IT TO PROPERLY OPERATING COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO HOLD LETTUCE UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. GLORY DAYS GRILL (Inspection Date: 12/02/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: OBSERVED SHIELDs MISSING FROM ALL LIGHTS IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PIC INFORMED EHS LIGHTS WERE CHANGED RECENTLY; PIC UNDERSTANDS PROTECTIVE SHIELDS SHOULD BE INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
